jobs.title: Senior Transfer Agent - Fund Operations

titleByLocale.it: Agente di trasferimento senior - Operazioni del Fondo

jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.

By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

Your role

• Monitor orders for UCI share subscriptions/redemptions, transfers and conversions.

• Prepare and send out confirmations and reports to promoters, distributors and other fund intermediaries.

• Respond rapidly to different requests from clients (inside and outside the Group) to guarantee that a quality service is provided that meets the requirements of a demanding client.

• Manage client commissions and dividends for in-house and third-party funds.

• Manage events on Funds (in kind transfers, launches, liquidations…).

• Work on automating various configurations within the tool “Multifonds Global Investor”, primarily focusing on Fund setup, by implementing key controls.

• Play a coordinating role in fund-related events across teams, including fund launches, compartments, classes, mergers, and liquidations.

• Review Fund’s prospectuses to ensure alignment between promoter requests and system feasibility.

• Offer technical and functional support to other teams within the service.

Your profile

• Extensive knowledge of the Transfer Agent business and all-round understanding of fund administration processes

• Unversity degree in Economics or Finance

• 5 years' experience in similar position

• Fluent in french and english

• Excellent knowledge of the “MFGI - Multifonds Global Investor” tool and proven experience in its usage.

• Extensive knowledge of the Office suite.

• SQL knowledge is a must have.

• Flexibility

• Ability to handle stress.

• Rigor in checking, sending, confirming and monitoring orders.

• Enthusiasm and drive and ability to show initiative in solving problems.

• Enquiring mind and ability to learn quickly.

• Team player.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager (1-Year Contract)
jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people.

Your role

Pictet is seeking to recruit a Marketing Manager (1-Year Contract) to work in the Marketing Asia - HKG team to support and coordinate marketing activities for Pictet Asset Management in Asia excluding Japan, contributing to brand visibility and business development in the region.

• Coordinate and execute regional marketing strategies and campaigns, including advertising, events, web, social media, and other marketing initiatives.

• Assist in the development and production of marketing collaterals, from information and data collection through to distribution, ensuring consistency with brand guidelines.

• Monitor the publication of global marketing content and support local content production and translation, liaising with external service providers as needed.

• Demonstrate creativity in developing innovative marketing campaigns and designing thoughtful client gifts that are highly valued and appreciated by recipients.

• Work closely with internal stakeholders, including local business teams, compliance, and headquarter marketing counterparts, to deliver marketing activities.

• Help maintain and update the firm’s web, digital, and social media platforms, ensuring content is accurate and engaging.

• Manage relationships with external vendors for the production of marketing assets, campaigns, events, and other communications materials.

• Track and report on marketing performance using analytics and KPIs, providing insights for ongoing improvement.

Your profile

• University graduate in Marketing, Communications, or a relevant discipline.

• 5-10 years of solid marketing and communications experience in financial institutions is highly preferred.

• Strong attention to detail and creativity.

• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and desktop publishing tools.

• Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) in English and Chinese.

• Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively in a diverse, multicultural environment.

• A proactive, results-oriented team player with a passion for marketing.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.title: Chef de Rang (fixed-term)
jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 31 offices in financial centers worldwide, currently employing more than 5’000 people. The group is owned and managed by eight partners and stands out as a company with an entrepreneurial spirit and loyalty. Pictet has been present in Zurich since 1982 where it employs over 200 people. The Zurich branch is located at the Leuenhof, one of the most historic buildings on the prestigious Bahnhofstrasse.

We are looking for a passionate Chef de Rang to join our team in Zurich. As a key member of our motivated team, you will be working for Food & Beverage activities, in our beautiful premises in the heart of Zurich.
You will bring your communication skills, your ability to work independently and your good knowledge of foreign languages to a service-oriented team that will appreciate your motivation, high quality standards and networked thinking. Your organizational skills and thoughtful approach to your work will enable you to maintain an overview even in hectic situations. You will use your sense of responsibility, pleasant manner and outstanding client focus to support our own staff as well as our clients.

Your role

You will manage the activities of the restaurant dedicated to the Bank's clients and management, as well as external and internal events (banquets and catering). You will be the main contact for the kitchen and reception teams and coordinate and perform all the Food & Beverage activities. As a Food & Beverage Coordinator, you provide a first-class Food & Beverage service with an emphasis on quality and always maintain absolute discretion. Working hours are primarily during office hours, with only occasional evening shifts.

Your responsibilities include the following:
• Plan and organize client lunches and hospitality service with or without external catering service
• Ensure the setting up of lounges or banquets according to the reservation forecasts and menus
• Take orders and propose food and wine pairings, if necessary
• Manage the wine cellar in coordination with Geneva’s F&B team
• Monitor the service and ensure its excellence
• Help to prepare client-facing events
• Ensure the maintenance of the material (silverware, glasses...), as well as its inventory
• Perform general administrative duties
• Participate in the establishment and improvement of standards and procedures

Your profile

• Hotel management training/apprenticeship
• At least 5 years of experience in a high-end hospitality environment or in a successful running restaurant
• Native German speaker, fluent in English and knowledge of French would be an advantage
• Service-oriented, smart and confident appearance
• Must be resident in Switzerland

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

You will be a member of the Quality Control & Mobile team , reporting to the head of the team.

In this role you will work on quality-control-related activities for the three teams ( Fund Accounting, Transfer Agency and Private Equity ) and occasionally provide support to the production teams during peak periods.

Your role

You will assist our Quality Control & Mobile team for the fund operations processes :

• Providing support operational teams in their daily tasks,

• Identifying areas of improvement in terms of the process and control framework,

• Contributing to the implementation of key quality control deliverables such as KPIs and the procedure framework review,

• Contributing to any other transversal project aimed at improving service delivery.

Your profile

Qualifications and experience:

• Pursuing a university degree in Finance, Economics or a related field.

Specific knowledge:

• Knowledge in fund operations,

• Experience in process and data analysis,

• Project management and organizational skills,

• Good Excel and PowerPoint skills.

Language skills:

• Spoken fluency in English and French.

Personal qualities:

• Flexibility and agility,

• Strong interpersonal skills that enable effective communication and collaboration with colleagues and clients.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.title: Banking Operations Officer (Fixed-term 12 months)
jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.

By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

Your role

The scope of the function is to oversee all the workflow from the trade reception, data analysis and life cycle data management to instruments pricing. The scope of asset includes listed products (equities, bonds, loan, derivatives), OTC products (IRS,CDS, FX & Equity options, TRS, CFD…) and Structured products (autocall, Reverse convertible, dual currency deposit, accumulator, Airbag…).

• Integration and control of assets opening in our global platform Neoxam.

• Control and publish prices, greeks, market data and analytics.

• Life cycle management of all Assets.

• Set up the necessary files to complement these feeds.

• Introduce the necessary settings for queries and Data/pricing flows for securities newly registered in our systems from our various financial information providers (Bloomberg, SIX, Reuters and ICE).

• Regularly check and update these settings.

• Provide the assistance requested by the various users of these Data (accountants for investment funds, valuers, administrators, asset managers, wealth managers, etc.).

• Challenge of various assets type with the counterparty's prices.

• Liaise directly with our main stakeholders in case of issue.

Your profile

Requested experience:

• Master’s degree in Finance, economics.

• 2 to 5 years’ experience minimum in a similar position.

Knowledge / technical skills:

• Good knowledge of financial products and good level in financial mathematic.

• Good knowledge of financial information providers.

• Skilled user of office software applications, especially Excel.

Soft skills:

• Driven and capable of showing initiative in solving problems.

• An enquiring mind with strong learning skills and a well-developed critical faculty.

• Accuracy and thoroughness in searching for the information required to value securities.

• Good capacity to collaborate and find win-win solution.

Language skills:

• French: fluent level

• English: good knowledge (written and spoken)

Note

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

Flexible and modern ways of working

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave.

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.

By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

The Role is to provide 1st level support on Fund Admnistration activities. To centralise, coordinate, and respond to Clients, Business Lines & Auditors requests and contribute to improvements of the processes, procedures and operational platforms to guarantee the proper application of controls and consistently exceed client’s needs and expectations.

Your role

• Collaborate with Business Implementation Team, Client Relationship Managers (CRM), Management Companies and other key stakeholders (Custody Bank, Pricing, Transfer Agent (TA)…) on Projects & fund-related events.

• Act as the main liaison for both external and internal Clients, as well as Auditors, regarding all Fund Administration day-to-day activities.

• Manage the end-to-end Audit process for the funds, from initial planning & timetable, preparation and coordination of the financial statements to final approval and CSSF filling. Respond to Audit queries and ensure timely implementation of corrective actions and / or process improvement & automation as needed.

• Support Fund Administration Operations teams and effectively manage relationships across various business lines, including CRM, Business Implementation Team, TA , Tax, and others.

• Demonstrate a proactive mindset in addressing fund-related issues, actively challenge the status quo, and contribute innovative ideas for process enhancement.

• Participate in due diligence meetings, service reviews, Client visits, and Board meetings as required.

• Monitor internal and external KPIs and take actions when needed

• Manage and resolve internal and external escalations, taking appropriate actions and escalating to management when necessary.

• Assist in the review of Operating Memorandum, Service Level Agreements, Prospectus, internal policies, procedures working instructions & check-list, RCSA Matrix and any other related documentation.

• Remain up to date with all internal policies and ensure strict adherence to legal and regulatory requirements.

• Act as back-up of Head of Client Services and participate in the Management Committee of the Funds Accounting Unit when required

Your profile

• Strong knowledge of financial products and funds regulation.

• Master's degree in Economics or Finance

• Min 10 years experience in Accounting

• Fluent in French and English

• In-depth understanding of Fund Administration and the relationships with the different stakeholders

• Experience in NAV calculations and NAV production

• Strong experience in financial reporting and audit process

• Good knowledge in foreign currency hedging and asset pooling techniques.

• Experience in fund events (merger, CIK/RIK, fund restructuring, etc.).

• Knowledge of Multifonds.

• Good knowledge in MS Office tool (mainly Excel).

• Flexibility - Can-do attitude

• Client oriented mindset.

• Sense of initiative and willing to learn.

• Strong analytical skills.

• Strong communication & presentation skills

• Rigorous and organized.

• Manage Stress and prioritization.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.description:
Your team

Les opérations assurent un traitement sécurisé et efficace des transactions bancaires et des fonds d'investissement de Pictet. Nos équipes veillent à ce que toutes les activités respectent les réglementations et gèrent les risques. En développant et en maintenant une infrastructure moderne et robuste, nous garantissons des services fiables et de haute qualité pour la gestion de patrimoine, la gestion d'actifs et de l’immobilier.
Contribuer à la préparation et transmission de documents et rapports financiers personnalisés, la vérification de la conformités des signatures et des instructions de paiement.
Vous jouerez un rôle central dans la transformation de nos activités, en étant moteur dans l’identification, la mise en place et l’optimisation de solutions d’automatisation et de digitalisation de nos processus, tout en veillant au respect des procédures internes et des exigences réglementaires et en soutenant les différentes lignes de métier de la Banque.

Your role

• Assurer la revue approfondie et la conformité des structures de comptes clients avant toute autorisation de paiement.
• Garantir la cohérence entre les directives internes et la validité des signatures pour les instructions de paiement.
• Préparer et fournir les documents contractuels et rapports financiers nécessaires aux visites clients.
• Générer des rapports financiers personnalisés à la demande des gestionnaires et des clients.
• Être moteur dans la transformation digitale du service : identifier, proposer et mettre en œuvre des solutions d’automatisation et d’intelligence artificielle adaptées à la réalité opérationnelle et réglementaire de Pictet.
• Participer activement à l’amélioration continue des méthodes de travail, en favorisant la standardisation, la réduction des tâches manuelles et l’industrialisation des contrôles de qualité.
• Répondre aux différentes demandes de l’ensemble des lignes de métier de la Banque concernant les activités du Client Register.

Your profile

• Formation CFC, Bachelor ou Master, idéalement complétée par une première expérience dans le secteur bancaire (Opérations ou IT).
• Polyvalence et curiosité : vous aimez apprendre, vous adapter et évoluer dans un environnement en transformation, et vous n’hésitez pas à sortir de votre zone de confort pour aider l’équipe sur des sujets variés.
• Intérêt marqué pour l’automatisation, la digitalisation et les nouvelles technologies, avec capacité à concevoir, maintenir ou améliorer des outils opérationnels automatisés (Python, SQL, low-code, LLMs, agents IA, etc.), dans le respect des standards de sécurité et de conformité.
• Excellente maîtrise des outils informatiques, notamment MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). La connaissance de l’outil bancaire Avaloq, un atout.
• Capacité à gérer plusieurs tâches et échéances dans un environnement dynamique, en priorisant la qualité, la fiabilité et la conformité.
• Sens du service client, excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et aptitude à collaborer efficacement avec des interlocuteurs variés (Front, IT, Data Office, Compliance, etc.).
• Maîtrise courante du français et de l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral. La connaissance de l’allemand est un atout.
• Résidence en Suisse obligatoire.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

## Mansioni

- Contribuire alla preparazione e trasmissione di documenti e rapporti finanziari personalizzati, la verifica della conformità delle firme e delle istruzioni di pagamento.
- Giocare un ruolo centrale nella trasformazione delle nostre attività, essendo motore nell'identificazione, la messa in atto e l'ottimizzazione di soluzioni di automazione e digitalizzazione dei nostri processi, tutto nel rispetto delle procedure interne e delle esigenze regolamentari e nel sostegno delle diverse linee di business della Banca.

## Ruolo

- Assicurare la revisione approfondita e la conformità delle strutture di conto dei clienti prima di qualsiasi autorizzazione di pagamento.
- Garantire la coerenza tra le direttive interne e la validità delle firme per le istruzioni di pagamento.
- Preparare e fornire i documenti contrattuali e i rapporti finanziari necessari alle visite dei clienti.
- Generare rapporti finanziari personalizzati a richiesta dei gestori e dei clienti.
- Essere motore nella trasformazione digitale del servizio: identificare, proporre e mettere in atto soluzioni di automazione e di intelligenza artificiale adatte alla realtà operativa e regolamentare di Pictet.
- Partecipare attivamente all'innovazione continua delle metodologie di lavoro, favorendo la standardizzazione, la riduzione delle attività manuali e l'industrializzazione dei controlli di qualità.
- Rispondere alle diverse richieste di tutte le linee di business della Banca relative alle attività del Registro dei Clienti.

## Profilo

- Formazione CFC, Bachelor o Master, ideale mente completata da una prima esperienza nel settore bancario (Operazioni o IT).
- Polyvalenza e curiosità: si ama imparare, adattarsi e evolversi in un ambiente in trasformazione, e non si esita a uscire dalla zona di comfort per aiutare l'équipe su argomenti variati.
- Interesse marcato per l'automazione, la digitalizzazione e le nuove tecnologie, con capacità di concepire, mantenere o migliorare strumenti operativi automatizzati (Python, SQL, low-code, LLMs, agenti IA, ecc.), nel rispetto dei standard di sicurezza e di conformità.
- Eccellente padronanza degli strumenti informatici, in particolare MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). La conoscenza dell'outil bancaire Avaloq, un atout.
- Capacità di gestire più compiti e scadenze in un ambiente dinamico, priorizzando la qualità, la fidelità e la conformità.
- Senso del servizio client, eccellenti competenze interpersonali e abilità di collaborare efficacemente con interlocutori variati (Front, IT, Data Office, Compliance, ecc.).
- Padronanza corrente del francese e dell'inglese, a scritto come a parlato. La conoscenza del tedesco è un atout.
- Residenza in Svizzera obbligatoria.

## Cosa offriamo

- Opportunità di crescita e sviluppo professionale in un ambiente dinamico e in trasformazione.
- Collaborazione con un team di professionisti appassionati e motivati.
- Accesso a formazione e sviluppo continua per migliorare le competenze e le abilità.
- Ambiente di lavoro inclusivo e diversificato.

## Contatto

- Per inviare il tuo curriculum, clicca sul pulsante "Invia il tuo curriculum".
- Per ulteriori informazioni, contatta il nostro team di reclutamento al seguente indirizzo email: [inserisci l'indirizzo email].
- Per salvare il lavoro, clicca sul pulsante "Salva il lavoro".
